note: Phase 8 ship 4 of the serial ladder: PR #138, STACKED on #136 (base ref ci/honest-checks, not main) -- the plan's '#138 before #136' ordering is INVERTED and was verified from the PR base refs, not assumed. Scope therefore covers both commits' files, because this branch's diff against main contains #136's. Reviewed on its own delta (REVIEW_SCOPE_BASE=<#136 head>) since #136 carried its own review and receipt. The load-bearing property here is that skipIfWalledPreview() puts the isPreviewHost gate INSIDE the helper, so a caller physically cannot green-skip production; the spec proves it by asserting fetch is never called for a prod base, and separately that a fetch throw (timeout/DNS) is never read as a wall. 24/24 previewProbe assertions pass. Expect a trivial arc-state conflict when #184 and then #136 land ahead of this; take the later phase/set_at and this ship's scope.
